ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
is_abi3:
- false
is_python_min:
- false
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.14.* *_cp314t
python_min:
- '3.11'
rust_compiler:
- rust
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - is_python_min
  - channel_sources
  - is_abi3
name: typst-py
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.15.1"

package:
  name: typst-py
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  # Building from the GitHub source as 0.15.1 was not published to PyPI.
  # Switch back to PyPI once https://github.com/messense/typst-py/issues/174 is resolved.
  url: https://github.com/messense/typst-py/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b924864f552326fefcdf75d30d30c0b8dec15f35042cf912a4253d7f847e09b1

build:
  number: 0
  # only build for the minimal python version
  skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
  python:
    version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
    content:
      # Remove this wrapper once https://github.com/conda-forge/rust-activation-feedstock/pull/79 is merged
      - if: unix
        then:
          - mkdir -p ${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin
          - cp ${RECIPE_DIR}/cargo-auditable-wrapper.sh ${BUILD_PREFIX}/bin/cargo-auditable-wrapper
          - export CARGO="cargo-auditable-wrapper"
        else:
          - copy %RECIPE_DIR%\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat %BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat
          - set "CARGO=cargo-auditable-wrapper.bat"
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable
    # needed to build the vendored openssl (only used on linux)
    - if: linux
      then: make
  host:
    - python
    - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
    - pip
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - typst
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - "*"
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min }}
  - if: is_abi3
    then:
      script:
        - if: win
          then: abi3audit %SP_DIR%/typst/_typst.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
          else: abi3audit $SP_DIR/typst/_typst.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
      requirements:
        run:
          - abi3audit


about:
  summary: Python binding to typst
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://github.com/messense/typst-py

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - freundTech
    - pavelzw
